title: Where Courage Comes From
question: What reason does God give Joshua to be strong and courageous instead of afraid?
blurb: A command to be brave that rests not on Joshua's strength, but on one promise: God goes with him wherever he goes.

nodes.content: What reason does God give Joshua to be strong and courageous instead of afraid?

nodes.verseText: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”
Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”
Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
